site.title: DCC-MCP Agent Skills
site.tagline: Discover and control 18 released creative applications plus 3 current Core application routes with typed DCC-MCP tools; route scoped application UI through project-owned DCC-CUA/ui-control.

agent_installers.name: Auto-detect
agent_installers.description: Detect a supported host in the current workspace and install the canonical Skill.

agent_installers.name: Codex
agent_installers.command:
codex plugin marketplace add dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-agent-plugins
codex plugin add dcc-mcp@dcc-mcp
agent_installers.description: Install the native Codex plugin from the DCC-MCP marketplace.

agent_installers.name: Claude Code
agent_installers.description: Run these two commands inside Claude Code to add the plugin.

agent_installers.name: Cursor
agent_installers.command: npx --yes skills@1.5.22 add dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-agent-plugins --skill dcc-mcp --agent cursor --copy --yes
agent_installers.description: Install into the current Cursor workspace with the shared Skills installer.

channels.name: skills.sh
channels.notes: No publish API. The directory indexes public repositories and ranks them from anonymous skills-CLI install telemetry. Release installs all four Skills from the public repository on Linux, macOS, and Windows and asserts the released version; it never generates telemetry.

channels.name: ClawHub
channels.notes: Validated Skill changes publish from main through scripts/clawhub_sync.py; tagged releases retry the same idempotent publication. Requires CLAWHUB_TOKEN.

channels.name: Smithery
channels.notes: GitHub-backed Skills registry. Published by scripts/smithery_sync.py. Requires SMITHERY_API_KEY.

channels.name: npm
channels.notes: Publishes the canonical Skill suite as a package so hosts can vendor it through node_modules. Requires NPM_TOKEN.

channels.name: GitHub Releases
channels.notes: Portable Agent Plugin archive plus per-Skill ZIPs.

channels.name: Claude community marketplace
channels.notes: Submit the repository through the Claude plugin submission form after `claude plugin validate ./plugins/dcc-mcp --strict` passes.

channels.name: OpenAI plugin directory
channels.notes: Skills-only submission. See SUBMISSION.md for the identity, policy URL, and review-case checklist.

channels.name: LobeHub Skills Marketplace
channels.notes: Indexes public Agent Skills repositories. Submit the repository URL; the catalog page and llms.txt provide the machine-readable metadata.

channels.name: Awesome lists
channels.notes: One-line entries for awesome-claude-code, awesome-agent-skills, and awesome-mcp style lists are generated into the catalog so submissions never drift from the released version.

channels.name: PulseMCP
channels.notes: Catalogs MCP Servers, not Agent Skills. Submit only when the owning Core/adapter release ships a public MCP endpoint. Do not represent an Agent Skill ZIP as an MCP Server.
